title: An opt-in self-only autopilot queue updates and verifies one eligible front PR at a time while preserving exact-head gates, independent work and each captain merge card
acceptance: Why. All normative requirements are contained in this spec, including self front-only coordination and external upstream isolation. The proposal PRD/source-scope files are nonnormative background documents to create/update in scope; no requirement or exact reason depends on their unavailable bytes. Current self update at fm_autopilot.py:513-518 updates every behind PR, and advance at fm_autopilot_loop.py:240-335 schedules independent gate work. Limit new landing-oriented updates/gates/cards to one durable front, while preserving feedback observation and exact existing evidence.

Policy. Add a data-only helper fm_autopilot_queue.py. Read optional real self state/autopilot/queue-policy.json, version1: enabled boolean, confirmed self repository/base, explicit cohort PR numbers (2-3 pilot), captain authorization reference and depth=1/batch=1. Absent/off keeps legacy behavior. Symlink, invalid/newer schema, changed repository/base or missing authorization reference while enabled yields an actionable hold before new queue mutations. External contexts do not apply scheduling from this file. They may read only its bounded strategy/enabled metadata to reject attempted self activation with one bounded notice; all upstream updates/review/gates remain unchanged. No config.yaml schema change or external default inheritance. Firstmate records activation only after normal captain approval of the exact cohort/pilot, not task dispatch alone; this task ships capability default-off. Exact activation interface is the self-owned JSON configuration file <FM_STATE_DIR>/autopilot/queue-policy.json with keys version, strategy="self-front", enabled, repository, base, cohort, captain_authorization, depth, batch. No ambient environment opt-in and no root config inheritance. External enabled=true or strategy=self-front configuration is rejected explicitly with bilingual self-strategy-not-supported attention and effective scheduling off; existing external update policy continues unchanged. Self enable requires repository/base match trusted context, exact confirmed cohort and recorded rollout approval. Operator stages validated config then normal autopilot reload, never starts a second coordinator. Authorization is an actual self decision record under state/decisions with chosen A, purpose decision, task T-260, self project and effect hold. Its retained authored details.en.notes contains exactly one object with kind note or caution and text Queue policy SHA-256: <D>. D is SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON encoded sort_keys=true,separators=(comma,colon), containing version,strategy,enabled,repository,base,sorted numeric cohort,depth,batch and excluding captain_authorization. No task dispatch card, empty reference, unresolved/pending card, another repository/cohort/digest, or a fabricated config boolean grants activation. The operator first publishes a reviewable rollout card with exact cohort/digest through stock fm-decide purpose decision; after real captain A, stages config with that decision id. Revalidate authorization on each enabled poll. A hold outcome means no automated card dispatch side effect; the scheduler capability consumes approval only for this explicit policy.

Whole-snapshot admission. During a complete successful authoritative PR poll, prepare admission and durable front from the full cohort before any per-PR update or landing advance; no front change based on partial API pages or failed reads. Persist stable admission sequence and owner/attempt generation in an additive versioned self_queue field of existing atomic autopilot state.json. Project-base, mapped ownership, valid approved task/pin and dispatch provenance, OPEN/non-draft, no live worker and resolved dependencies are required; historical approved dispatch provenance follows existing supported legacy record rules rather than requiring only a new card type. Stack-on-task and untracked PRs are outside queue admission. Independent work and normal feedback observation remain active. Admission MUST NOT require current implementation APPROVE: an unreviewed but otherwise eligible completed task may be front, and its existing gate6 failure/stock reviewer launch proceeds normally. Initial cohort sequence sorts numeric PR number independent of REST order; later admissions append monotonic durable sequence after complete-snapshot sorting.

Admission enforcement. Only selected front may start automatic self update_branch, protocol/gate advance or a new merge_card. Guard each entry point and each delayed job-to-review/gate/card continuation against current turn generation and authoritative PR/head/base before new side effects. The old poll order calls advance before update; rearrange only the opted-in self scheduling path so an observed behind front requests base update rather than gates known stale data. Existing off/external paths retain order and behavior. A nonfront job already owned at activation can finish, but cannot publish a stale new card; initial activation stays observation-only until prior landing mutations/jobs are settled. Do not kill healthy jobs or cancel initial worker feedback CI.

State and failure. Implement observed/queued/blocked/front/updating/waiting-ci/verifying/waiting-captain/merging/landed/parked/uncertain states and reasons defined below in this spec. Same failed head parks its attempt; independent eligible work can become front, children remain dependency-blocked. Changing head or explicit reconciliation can readmit with stable sequence. Pending/unknown checks wait; failed checks cannot be skipped. Captain wait retains front, explicit captain park uses existing card/task controls; a possibly running merge prevents release. No automatic timeout steals a live owner's turn and no hidden priority insertion. A parked known failed attempt cannot be readmitted from an unchanged poll: require changed head OR changed authoritative check-run/status identity/version after explicit approved remediation/retry OR a retained firstmate diagnosis/resume action. Do not silently rerun identical failed checks. Store failed evidence fingerprint and resume cause. A pending merge slot blocks competing fronts/cards, not same-front base catch-up or gates required by an already-running authorized T220 carry. A pending captain card keeps reservation; no broad merge_blocker check may deadlock its front.

Recovery. Reuse existing owned service/lifeline/start/service locks and job/marker/decision records. Persist request identity before remote update; reconcile expected-head outcome, actual remote merge and canonical events before releasing once. A restart preserves turn identity and inspects live jobs/merge helpers before admission. Unknown ownership or transport outcome is uncertain, not a retry or success. Head/base/input change rejects old candidate readiness; existing binding/gate/merge commands remain authoritative. Disable drains current known-owned work or holds uncertain work before returning to legacy fanout; do not delete queue state, reset branches or kill service processes.

Visibility. New helper offers read-only status JSON and readable report from supplied real state. Reuse existing bilingual autopilot waiting/attention projection and bounded data, deduplicated by state transition identity; include task/PR/state/reason/next action/head/base/generation. No new event enum, board files or private external payload. Dedicated board queue presentation is a separate optional successor. Record update/gate invalidation/captain-wait/turn timing counters with precise definitions; do not claim model-predicted savings as measured results. Exact read-only command is python3 <FM_CODE_ROOT>/bin/lib/fm_autopilot_queue.py status --state <self-state-dir> --format json|text; validates schema/project without creating locks/files, polling network or advancing a turn. Document fields and output examples in firstmate skill and PRD. Test no-write/read-only behavior and unknown-state diagnostic. status accepts exactly status --state <absolute-self-state-directory> --format json|text. Exit0 for valid status (including policy off), exit3 for absent queue record with a bounded not initialized response, exit64 for bad argv, exit65 for corrupt/newer/nonself state or symlinked state/record. Read only canonical state/autopilot/state.json queue allowlist fields: repository,base,enabled,front,sequence,generation,states/reasons/PR/task/head/base identifiers,counters. Never print state directory paths, operator names, raw logs, external payload or authorization prose. No create/open-for-write lock, network or process probe. Counters: automatic_updates_requested increments once per persisted request identity; completed_landings increments once per authoritative PR merge reconciliation; invalidated_gate_jobs counts one completed owned job whose bound H/B differs before readiness/card use; captain_wait_seconds accumulates wall-clock interval waiting-captain with persisted timestamps once on transition (clamp nonnegative); front_seconds similarly sums front acquisition to terminal release; duplicate effects observed counts only confirmed duplicate request identities. Report unavailable CI runner-minute data as unavailable, not estimated.

Safety and docs. Phase2 candidate SHA/tree evidence substitution, batching/promotion and GitHub queue settings are forbidden. T220 carry is not required; before it ships a moved candidate uses existing fresh-card behavior. If active T220 carry is present, the same reserved front retains permission to catch up/gate without deadlock. Edit existing design §15.8 autonomous supervisor/branch updates and firstmate scheduling guidance in place, no tail section. Update proposal rollout/status documentation. No changes to required checks, signatures, pin format, approval markers, merge primitive, per-PR captain authority or external conventions.

Tests. New feature suite/helper use mocked GitHub/disposable state and controlled lifeline fixtures. Test off/external identical behavior, cohort polling order independence, only-front three-PR updates across base merge, actual head/base race refusals, delayed job continuation generation checks, worker/draft/dependency/cycle blocking, CI failure independent progress, captain wait, duplicate card suppression, crash at update/job/card/merge boundaries, live-owner non-stealing, unknown schema/repository fail-closed, disable drain and bilingual dedup. Retain complete harness/API for prior all-PR update mutation proof. Existing loop/jobs/entrypoints/external regressions run unchanged except intentional fixture contract updates. No removed assertions, sleep-order races or production timeout change. Current-head full CI and six gates remain necessary for merge. Exact copy inventory: tests/lib/autopilot_entrypoints.py:29-34 explicitly copies selected shell/storage modules; add fm_autopilot_queue.py only where its real executable/context path needs it. tests/lib/autopilot_branch_fixture.py is a probe fixture and has no engine copy list; tests/lib/project-storage.sh copies storage helpers, not an autopilot engine, so no new copy edit there is required. tests/lib/autopilot_reload.py copies entire bin but must verify retained/updated snapshots both import the helper through the pinned code root. tests/lib/autopilot_loop.py and autopilot_jobs.py import the actual root bin/lib and need no engine-copy change. New queue suite copies complete required modules explicitly and names those dependencies. Inventory remaining actual autopilot startup fixtures before implementation and report any missed production/test scope. Activation authority feature tests use genuine stock-shaped notes arrays of {kind:"note"|"caution",text:string}, real decision/request/answer flow fixtures and canonical decision_made data. Require genuine rollout acceptance, forged valid-looking reference rejection, answered file without event rejection, duplicate/conflicting digest note rejection, wrong task/project/purpose or dispatch card rejection, changed cohort/base/digest rejection and approval revoked/replaced before a local delayed job completion rejection. Revalidate current policy+record+event BEFORE consume_jobs in local() as well as every poll, so no prior authorization cache permits a card/review/gate after revocation. These are new feature behaviors red on base, not unchanged regression claims.

Migration and trial. Absent self_queue state is legacy/off; no existing pin/card/PR rewritten. Old frozen snapshots retain old behavior until normal self-update. Enabled restart resumes recognized versioned turn state; unknown version holds rather than silently restoring fanout. Task implementation approval does not activate policy: firstmate prepares concrete 2-3 independent self PR cohort and baseline for separate captain pilot decision. No dependency on T246/T242/T220 landing is required for core implementation; overlapping scheduler source with live T239/T254 must be cleared by normal dispatch scheduling, not erased from scope. External work and phase2 remain excluded. Seed explicit upgrade cases with valid existing stock-approved pins and historical dispatch/legacy approval records; preserve their exact bytes and existing stock validity restrictions. Seed legacy job packets without queue binding, pending merge cards, answered held cards, running/uncertain merge answers and unresolved owner receipts. Activation stays observation-only for each unresolved class, does not rewrite pin/card/job records or launch an old nonfront continuation. Test successful reconciliation then normal enabled operation, disable while each class remains live/uncertain, and exactly-once return to legacy scheduling only after known-owned front settles. Assert canonical pin/card bytes and state history unchanged apart from additive queue fields, with fresh/retained snapshot coverage in scoped reload helpers.

Independent audit closure 1-3, policy and captain identity. Valid policy has exactly version,strategy,enabled,repository,base,cohort,captain_authorization,depth,batch; no unknown keys. version/depth/batch are integer1 and not boolean/float; enabled is boolean; cohort is 2-3 unique positive integer PR numbers not bool, sorted canonically; strategy exactly self-front; repository/base exactly trusted context; authorization a stock valid decision id string. Reject symlinked policy or ancestor within self state. Absent/off policy preserves legacy only when no active/uncertain turn exists; invalid policy with active turn retains hold/drain rather than fanout. External absent/off ignores content scheduling, attempted enabled self strategy emits bounded rejection, malformed policy emits bounded policy diagnostic but never changes upstream scheduling. Activation requires BOTH matching answered record and decision_made event for that id/project/task/choice, resolved retained card details and exactly one object in details.en.notes whose text is Queue policy SHA-256: D and kind is note or caution with no conflicting duplicate; compare D against approved details and canonical current policy. A valid-looking answered file without canonical event is not activation authority. Supported old decision records retain their existing provenance label; no signed pin/evidence format changes.

Independent audit closure 4, queue schema and receipts. self_queue version1 stores policy_digest(string64hex), repository/base(strings), enabled(bool), next_sequence(positiveint), owner_generation(nonnegativeint), owner_receipt object, members keyed by positive numeric PR strings and front either null or matching member id. Each member stores task, admission_sequence, head/base_sha(40hex), state enum observed|queued|blocked|front|updating|waiting-ci|waiting-review|verifying|waiting-captain|merging|landed|parked|uncertain, reason bounded500chars, attempt_generation(nonnegativeint), failed_fingerprint or null, resume_decision or null, request or null, jobs list, card_id or null and timestamps. Each request stores unique request_id, kind update, H/B/policy/turn generation, state planned|issued|accepted|uncertain|settled and observed outcome. Invalid fields hold enabled queue. Persist sequence once; increment attempt_generation for H/B/policy change or authorized retry, never unchanged poll. Logical owner receipt uses existing owner.json owner/requested/pid/code/started_ok tuple AND actual exclusive service.lock/lifeline ownership; PID alone is no proof and no fabricated transport authentication claim is added. Reload increments owner_generation only after supported owned service takeover, retains attempt generations and reconciles jobs. New job packets/results bind policy_digest, admission_sequence, attempt_generation,H,B; validate on every protocol-to-gate, gate6-to-review, review-to-gate and gate-to-card continuation. Legacy jobs lack those fields and are drain/observation-only during activation, not silently adopted into queue.

Independent audit closure 5-6, snapshot and request outcomes. Build turn from complete open-list pagination plus authoritative details/checks/reviews for each cohort member and live base. An absent open-list member requires explicit PR lookup and verified closed/merged/draft state; absence never releases. Any incomplete member read retains prior reservation and forbids mutation; changed B between preparation and effect invalidates attempt before revalidation. Enabled self update writes planned request intent before HTTP; known not-issued refusal can settle locally, accepted response records outcome, transport timeout/lost response is uncertain until remote reconciliation. Async sameH cannot retry because20 polls elapsed. Verify H1 base-only ancestry and task ownership after observed update; unrelated worker push invalidates attempt rather than being counted as queue update success. Missing ancestry/read proof holds uncertain. Remote merged plus canonical merged event settles landed/release exactly once. Existing off/external update request/retry behavior is unchanged.

Independent audit closure 7, review/park/resume. Missing approval gate exit6 is waiting-review and invokes the existing stock review continuation, then fresh gates/card for the same front; it is not parked as failed CI. Required CI failure is blocked failed-ci, signed REJECT is blocked rejected-review, pending/missing checks are waiting-ci, transport/ownership unknown is uncertain. Resume of same failed head requires a real chosenA purpose-decision self T260 card AND matching decision_made event whose details.en.notes contains exactly one object with kind note or caution and text Queue resume: PR N head H failed fingerprint F; reject arbitrary text or state-file cause as authority. New check identity is admissible only with that explicit approved retry/remediation reference, not any changed unrelated check. Head change re-enters after normal worker/dependency checks preserving sequence. Explicit parked/captain park via existing board controls removes an attempt only after pending card cancellation is canonically recorded and no running/uncertain merge remains. T220 exception needs actual running merge record/helper ownership and expected_head/task bound to this front; a merely planned T220 task/card does not qualify. Actual task control events are parked/unparked, not task_parked; parking alone leaves a pending merge card active and therefore retains the reservation. Cancellation requires a SEPARATE actual captain answer to that pending merge card: chosen B or C whose effective effectOf is hold (check authored effect mapping; do not assume a letter with custom merge effect is cancellation). Verify matching answered decision record, canonical captain decision_made event with that decision/chosen/effect=hold and successful outcome, and absence of pending/<id>.json. If emission failed, pending still exists, answered choice remains merge, or a running/uncertain merge owner is observed, do not release. No automatic card answer/removal or board change. A task parked/unparked event without this card action cannot cancel readiness authority. Test parking alone, completed separate B/C hold answer, conflicting authored option effects, event failure, pending-removal race and competing/running merge ownership. Existing board/server.ts behavior remains unchanged.

Independent audit closure 8-9, activation drain and status identity. Activation remains observation-only while existing legacy gate/protocol/review jobs are running/consuming/uncertain, a cohort pending merge card exists, any answered merge is running or unresolved, or its marker/helper owner cannot be reconciled. Already-completed known results may be observed but cannot spawn stale cards under enabled generation. Disable permits required continuations of the existing known front through its owned review/gates/captain merge to settle, while preventing new turn acquisition or nonfront update; uncertain turn stays held. After settlement, legacy resumes exactly once. Unknown schema/config cannot trigger that resume. Read-only status derives trusted self engine from resolved code parent or stock FM_ENGINE_ROOT and requires --state equal canonical engine/state; no environment-supplied project field or untrusted queue repository alone proves self identity. External state, symlinked parents, absent state directory, malformed state return65 except missing queue in valid self state returns3. Output front has only PR/task/state/H/B/generation/reason, members add sequence/state, reasons<=500chars; no paths/authorization prose. Verify unchanged bytes+mtime, no mkdir/locks/network/process probes. Duration counters persist accounted transition ids so replay cannot double-add or use negative wall time.

Independent audit closure10, exact regression inventory. Preserve tests/autopilot.test.sh→tests/lib/autopilot_cases.py; autopilot-loop.test.sh→autopilot_loop.py; autopilot-jobs.test.sh→autopilot_jobs.py; autopilot-entrypoints.test.sh→autopilot_entrypoints.py; autopilot-reload.test.sh→autopilot_reload.py; autopilot-merge-path.test.sh and its existing helper; external-adopt/stacking/restack suites with their existing fixtures; external-reviews.test.sh; external-pr-format.test.sh→external_pr_format.py. New queue import must be lazy/guarded so off/external isolated legacy fixtures without the new helper still execute; enabled missing helper refuses safely. Do not widen scope to every copied fixture merely to satisfy an unconditional import. New queue mutation proof retains complete harness/helper API and swaps scheduler admission to legacy all-PR update behavior, showing concrete wrong-front/update-count assertions rather than import error. Feature tests record test-only helper classification truthfully; actual autopilot production changes require current ordinary fail-first evidence.
